slides.label: Gray wolf
heading: Every species is different.
The need for oxygen is universal.
slides.description: BHOC is developing a next-generation oxygen-delivery platform for veterinary medicine, including companion, wildlife, exotic and endangered species.

comparison.alt: BHOC versus red blood cell size comparison

benefits: Designed to reduce dependence on red-cell blood-group matching.

slides.closing: Development objectives. Product- and species-specific evidence is required.
